entities.name: Silas Simmons
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Silas Joseph Simmons was an American professional baseball player for African-American teams in the pre-Negro leagues era. He became the longest-lived major league player in history, surpassing Red Hoff, who died at age 107 in 1998.
